name: demo-recording
description: Record narrated, subtitled product demo videos of the live app from a versioned script (Playwright + Kokoro TTS + ffmpeg): a .demo.yml that reads like a user story and carries no selectors, a visible cursor, narration the pacing is built around, one-line passing subtitles, a coverage catalog of what you still have nothing to show for, and publish to S3 with no binaries in git.
